title: Kernel-check MurmurHash streaming partitions and partial reset
description: Induct over complete four-byte blocks and zero to three pending bytes in an executable bit-vector model. Compare arbitrary finite partitions with the independent block traversal, length modulo 32 bits, reset and final mixing. Bind release class bytes and disprove the old signed-tail result on ff.
expected: The Lean kernel checks the partition and reset theorems and rejects the false digest.
